description: This file defines a React functional component called TagsListItem, which represents an individual item in a list of tags with features such as editing, collapsing/expanding child tags, context menu, drag-and-drop, and interaction with navigation and features controllers.

methods.name: toggleChildren
methods.description: Handles toggling the expanded/collapsed state of child tags and updates the navigation controller accordingly.

methods.name: selectCurrentTag
methods.description: Selects the current tag via the navigation controller.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Saves the tag title when the input loses focus.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Updates the local state with the current value of the tag title input.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events in the editing input; commits edits on Enter key.

methods.name: onSubtagInputBlur
methods.description: Creates and associates a new subtag when the subtag input loses focus.

methods.name: onSubtagKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for subtag input; commits on Enter key.

methods.name: toggleContextMenu
methods.description: Opens or closes the context menu for a tag.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Initiates dragging with the tag UUID.

methods.name: onDragEnter
methods.description: Handles drag enter event to indicate a valid drop zone.

methods.name: removeDragIndicator
methods.description: Removes visual indicator for drag over state.

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: Handles drag over event to allow drop.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping a dragged tag onto this tag, potentially reassigning parent.
